note: Adapted from the original description in Holmgren (1913) Termitenstudien 4. Versuch einer systematischen Monographie der Termiten der orientalischen Region (Kungliga Svenska Vetenskaps-Akademiens Handlingar 50(2): 1–276), in German; the original was published under the name Eutermes (E.) flavicans n. sp., with a soldier and a worker described and the alate recorded as “unbekannt”. The original plate (Tafel VII, Fig. 11) and the locality details were not entered; the measurements are transcribed from the original tables. Ahmad (1965) distinguished this species from its close relatives by the 12-segmented soldier antennae, in agreement with the original account.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier: head brownish yellow, abdominal tergites brownish, rest of the body straw yellow; head very sparsely hairy, abdominal tergites with only a row of setae. Head pyriform, very weakly constricted; nasus short, cylindrical; frontal profile only very weakly raised at the base of the nasus. Antennae 12-segmented, segment 3 much longer than segment 2 (club-shaped), segment 4 about as long as segment 3 but thicker. Pronotum slightly saddle-shaped, anterior margin not incised. Body length 3.3 mm; head length with nasus 1.37 mm, without nasus 0.8 mm; head width 0.70 mm; pronotum width 0.42 mm. Worker: head yellow, body nearly white, antennae 13-segmented, head width 0.95 mm. Alate unknown.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head brownish yellow, abdominal tergites brownish, rest of the body straw yellow. Head very sparsely hairy, abdominal tergites with only a row of setae. Head pyriform, very weakly constricted; nasus short, cylindrical; frontal profile with a very weak elevation at the base of the nasus. Antennae 12-segmented; segment 3 much longer than segment 2 (club-shaped); segment 4 about as long as segment 3 but thicker. Pronotum slightly saddle-shaped, anterior margin not incised. Body length 3.3 mm; head length with nasus 1.37 mm; head length without nasus 0.8 mm; head width 0.70 mm; pronotum width 0.42 mm. Locality: Sarawak, Borneo (collected by Haviland).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head yellow, body nearly white. Head and abdominal tergites sparsely hairy. Head broadly oval; head suture visible; frontal gland rather large but indistinct. Anteclypeus short, flat. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 2 about equal to segments 3 and 4 together; segment 4 longer than segment 3. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin not incised. Body length 3.5 mm; head width 0.95 mm; pronotum width 0.49 mm.
